turns.content: "Welcome everyone. Today we're discussing TechFlow, a B2B SaaS company with $12M ARR facing declining margins. Our goal is to identify ways to improve profitability by 5 percentage points. Alex, Jordan, Sam - what initial questions or thoughts do you have?"
